title: Director of Operational Excellence $25K Sign On and $10K Relocation
text:
Pay Range:$65.73 - $92.22 Salary Range: $136,718 - $191,817
 
 
$25K Sign On and $10K Relocation for qualified hire!
 
 
The Director of Operational Excellence leads SEARHC’s improvement function, translating annual operating plan priorities into measurable, sustainable operational results. Reporting directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence, the Director supervises Associate Program Managers, Program Managers, and Senior Program Managers, develops improvement and change capabilities, balances team assignments and capacity, and oversees delivery quality and benefits measurement. This hands-on leader personally leads selected complex transformations and partners with executive sponsors and operational owners to diagnose problems, redesign processes, implement change, and sustain results. The Senior Program Manager level expands advanced program leadership capacity while the Director remains accountable for the function and continues direct involvement in transformational projects. The Director works with the PMO through one integrated portfolio and common reporting approach. The System Director retains enterprise direction and executive alignment; operational sponsors retain accountability for operational decisions, resources, and sustained performance.
 
 
SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.
 
 
Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.
 
 
**Key Essential Functions And Accountabilities Of The Job**

* Leads the Operational Excellence team and translates approved annual operating plan priorities into a coordinated improvement work plan; personally leads selected highly complex efforts while maintaining capacity for staff leadership and development.
* Integrates related improvement work across functions and operational owners; develops coherent transformation approaches, resolves cross-workstream dependencies, and coordinates supporting projects with the PMO through shared portfolio processes.
* Advises sponsors on competing approaches, sequencing, risks, and tradeoffs; facilitates difficult cross-functional decisions and escalates resource and priority decisions through established governance without assuming executive approval authority.
* Synthesizes complex operational, quality, service, and financial information with specialist partners; establishes credible baselines and benefits measures, examines performance variation, and evaluates outcomes, unintended effects, and sustained benefits.
* Assigns improvement work, balances team capacity, and oversees plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and delivery quality within approved priorities and resources; partners with the PMO on common reporting and escalates capacity and priority tradeoffs to the System Director.
* Leads change-impact assessment, stakeholder alignment, readiness, and adoption planning for complex transformations; partners on communication and training and verifies that new practices are used across affected operations.
* Leads advanced performance diagnosis, workflow and operating-model redesign, structured testing, and implementation; establishes standard work, measurement ownership, review routines, and transition plans with operational owners to sustain results.
* Develops executive-level updates, governance materials, and strategic implementation reporting for leaders and decision-making bodies.
* Supervises, coaches, and develops improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels; establishes role-appropriate performance expectations, evaluates performance, supports recruitment and onboarding, and builds reusable improvement and change methods to strengthen team capability and consistency.
* Demonstrates SEARHC’s values and supports work that advances the organization’s mission, vision, strategic plan, and operating plan.
* Other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities
 
 
This position reports directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence and directly supervises improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels. Responsibilities include staff performance management, coaching and development, assignments, workload balancing, and delivery oversight in accordance with organizational policies. Senior Program Managers provide technical coaching and program leadership; the Director retains personnel and assignment authority across all levels. The System Director retains enterprise direction, executive alignment, and escalation of enterprise priority and resource decisions.
 
 
**Additional Details**
**Education, Certifications, and Licenses Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, nursing, or a related field
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare, operational improvement, program management, or project management experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
* Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, or a related field preferred
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, change management, or similar improvement methodology training/certification preferred

**Experience Required**

* Six to eight or more years of experience in healthcare operations, program management, project management, quality improvement, or operational improvement, including independent leadership of complex, ambiguous, enterprise-wide improvement programs with measurable and sustained results
* Experience advising executive sponsors, integrating changes across multiple operational owners, facilitating consequential cross-functional decisions, and supervising and developing professional staff
* Demonstrated advanced expertise in performance diagnosis, process redesign, change adoption, benefits measurement, and sustainment across complex healthcare operations, with experience managing staff performance, assignments, and workload

**Knowledge of**

* Healthcare operations, workflow design, and advanced performance improvement principles
* Advanced improvement methods, including process mapping, root cause analysis, structured testing, performance variation, operating-model redesign, and outcome, process, and balancing measures
* Project and program management practices, including planning, tracking, risk management, issue escalation, and cross-functional integration across large or interdependent initiatives
* Data analysis, reporting, and use of healthcare operational and performance metrics to support executive decision-making
* Advanced change-impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, readiness and adoption measurement, capability building, standard work, sustainment, and shared governance principles
* Regulatory, accreditation, and compliance considerations that affect healthcare operations and process redesign
* Staff supervision, performance management, professional development, workload planning, and improvement practice management

Skills in
 
 

* Building effective working relationships with leaders, providers, staff, and cross-functional teams, including senior leaders, governance participants, and executive stakeholders
* Facilitating complex meetings, work sessions, governance discussions, decision-making, and follow-through across multiple stakeholders
* Using standard business software and healthcare information systems to organize work, analyze information, and communicate effectively
* Communicating clearly and effectively in written, verbal, presentation, and executive reporting formats
* Coaching and developing improvement professionals, setting clear expectations, balancing assignments, and providing constructive performance feedback

Ability to
 
 

* Facilitate complex problem-solving, support conflict resolution, and help remove high-level operational barriers to execution across enterprise or highly interdependent initiatives
* Influence without direct authority, foster collaboration, and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, tradeoffs, and execution plans
* Analyze complex issues, develop practical recommendations, and support implementation of operational change across multiple functions or enterprise priorities
* Work effectively with people from diverse disciplines, backgrounds, and perspectives
* Adapt to changing organizational priorities, healthcare environments, and operational demands while maintaining momentum across complex initiatives

**Position Information**
Work Shift:Exempt
 
 
*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*
